from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    q = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if (0 <= q[0] < h and 0 <= q[1] < w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]] == color):
                        seen.add(q)
                        stack.append(q)
            top, left = min(y for y, x in cells), min(x for y, x in cells)
            bottom, right = max(y for y, x in cells), max(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = {(y - top, x - left) for y, x in cells}
            objects.append((left, color, bottom - top + 1, right - left + 1, shape))
    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: obj[0])
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    row = col = 0
    for i, (_, color, oh, ow, shape) in enumerate(objects):
        for y, x in shape:
            if row + y < h and col + x < w:
                out[row + y][col + x] = color
        if i + 1 < len(objects):
            row += oh - 1
            col += ow - 1
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-16a1d14d.py'
path.write_text(code)
